title: Work with us - join DrCertificate as a doctor
description: Registered doctors in Southeast Asia: review medical certificate requests online with DrCertificate. Apply and sign online in six short steps.

blocks.text: DrCertificate connects patients with registered doctors who review their requests online and issue medical certificates when they're clinically appropriate. We're looking for doctors to join us.

items: Registered doctors only We verify every registration
Six short steps Apply and sign online

blocks.text: Patients send their requests through DrCertificate, and you review each one online.
You decide whether a certificate is appropriate, and you stay clinically responsible for every case you sign.
A free listing for your clinic
We can show your clinic on DrCertificate at no charge, and refer patients who want to be seen in person.
We work with doctors registered in Southeast Asia who want to help patients get the medical certificates they need, quickly and properly.

items: You are registered and licensed to practise medicine in one of our 10 countries
You can share your registration number and a current CV
You are comfortable reviewing patient requests online
You can consult in English or another language our patients speak

blocks.text: From application to your first case

items: 1 Fill in the application Six short steps: your details, registration, practice address, documents, how you'd like to work and the agreement.
2 Sign the agreement online Read the doctor terms and sign with your mouse, finger or stylus, or type your name. We email you a copy with a PDF record.
3 We verify your registration We check your registration with your medical council or ministry of health.
4 We contact you with next steps Once you're verified, we email you to get you started.
Your registration number As issued by your medical council
Your CV PDF or Word, up to 3 MB
Registration certificate Optional, but it usually speeds up the check
Your practice address Or where you usually work, if you don't have a clinic

blocks.text: Apply in six short steps. Questions first? Email care@drcertificate.com .
